_comment: Full of round holes, cut through whatever it is said of: the rock in isolated voids you break into, the land holed
through above the ground, the ground pitted like pumice, what the features and structures build holed, the sea holding
bubbles of air, the clouds a sheet with round holes. A way of wear, so `ancient porous` is holed through at a great
amount. Said of the whole Age, only the rock.
